Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Columbia, South Carolina Wikipedia page and incorrectly stated that Columbia is the county seat of Lexington County. The page actually says Columbia is the county seat of Richland County, with portions extending into Lexington and Kershaw counties. This misinterpretation led to an incorrect county conclusion at that step.
